strings.内置解压引擎，支持 RAR、ZIP、7z、TAR、ISO 等格式。\n拖入普通文:
Built-in extraction for RAR, ZIP, 7z, TAR, ISO and more.
Drop files or folders to create a RAR5 archive.
strings.密码通过标准输入传递，不写入命令参数或设置。加密任务期间日志在结束后显示。新建仅: Passwords use standard input, never command arguments or settings. Encrypted task logs appear after completion. Creates new RAR5 archives without overwriting existing archives.
strings.已内置 7-Zip，浏览、解压和测试无需安装。RAR 创建与恢复数据仍需单独配置: 7-Zip is included for browsing, extraction and testing. RAR creation and recovery require a separately licensed RARLAB tool.
strings.打开压缩包，或拖入文件创建 RAR: Open an archive, or drop files to create RAR
strings.存在重复路径，无法可靠选择条目。: Duplicate paths prevent reliable item selection.
strings.压缩包包含不安全路径或链接。此原型拒绝解压，请使用受信任的独立工具检查。: This archive contains unsafe paths or links. Extraction was refused; inspect it with a trusted tool.
strings.为原压缩包添加 3% 恢复记录？: Add a 3% recovery record to the original archive?
strings.在压缩包旁创建 10% 恢复卷？: Create 10% recovery volumes beside the archive?
strings.恢复记录会修改原 RAR；恢复卷需要分卷 RAR。请保留备份。: Recovery records modify the original RAR. Recovery volumes require a multi-volume RAR. Keep a backup.
strings.目标目录中已有同名前缀的分卷，请换一个文件名。: Volumes with this name already exist. Choose another name.
strings.已取消；可能留下不完整输出，请检查目标目录。: Cancelled. Partial output may remain; check the destination.
strings.CLI 退出码 {0}。请查看 stderr/stdout。密码错误时可输入密码: Engine exit code {0}. Check stderr/stdout. If the password is wrong, enter it and reload.
strings.密码不能含换行、NUL，且不能超过 127 个 Unicode 码点。: Passwords cannot contain newlines or NUL and must not exceed 127 Unicode code points.
strings.此条目名称含 CLI 模式字符或不安全路径，无法可靠地按选中项解压。: This item contains wildcard characters or an unsafe path and cannot be safely extracted by selection.
strings.请选择文件；分卷范围 0–1000000 MB，恢复记录范围 0–100%。: Select files; volume size must be 0–1000000 MB and recovery record 0–100%.
strings.请选择尚不存在的 .rar 文件名。: Choose a new .rar filename that does not already exist.
strings.源名称含不支持的换行或通配符。: Source names contain unsupported newlines or wildcards.
strings.此原型要求源文件位于同一文件夹；可直接选择它们的共同父文件夹。: Source items must share one parent folder. You may select their common parent folder instead.
strings.输出压缩包不能保存在选中的源文件夹内。: The output archive cannot be inside a selected source folder.
strings.CLI 路径必须是可执行文件的绝对路径：{0}: The engine path must be an absolute path to an executable: {0}
strings.下载页面请选择 macOS ARM（Apple Silicon）或 x64（In: Choose macOS ARM (Apple Silicon) or x64 (Intel) on the download page. Unpack it, then select the rar executable above.
strings.RAR 创建与恢复数据需要单独安装 RARLAB 工具。可打开官网下载，解包后在: RAR creation and recovery require the RARLAB tool. Download it from the official website, unpack it, and select rar in Settings.
strings.语言包只能包含文字；缺失条目会回退到英语。系统文件对话框与 CLI 原始日志可能: Language packs contain text only; missing entries fall back to English. System dialogs and raw CLI logs may use the system or tool language.
